name: payout-gate
description: Concurrent Mozaik agents that hold a payout when its account changes mid-batch. Synthetic data only. Not financial advice.

scripts.demo: tsx src/cli.ts run --scenario payout-change --mode concurrent --inference scripted
scripts.demo:sequential: tsx src/cli.ts run --scenario payout-change --mode sequential --inference scripted
scripts.demo:pledge: tsx src/cli.ts run --scenario double-pledge --mode concurrent --inference scripted --scale demo
scripts.demo:pledge:sequential: tsx src/cli.ts run --scenario double-pledge --mode sequential --inference scripted --scale demo
scripts.live: tsx src/cli.ts run --scenario payout-change --mode concurrent --inference live
scripts.web:condense-live: npm run web:condense -- live/payout-change-t20/concurrent-20000 live/payout-change-t20/sequential-20000 live/double-pledge-t20/concurrent-20000 live/double-pledge-t20/sequential-20000
